title: Clear TenantList typescript:S3776 by re-measuring the rule instead of trusting the diff
goal: The 2026-10-28-release-gate-green packet (PR #463) claimed the typescript:S3776 finding on frontend/src/modules/system/iam/tenant/TenantList.tsx was cleared by collapsing five isAdmin || hasPerm('...') sequences into can(perm). main's next SonarCloud analysis (revision 1ae6481c, 2026-10-28T14:19Z) still reported the issue at complexity 16. Re-measuring with eslint-plugin-sonarjs@3's sonarjs/cognitive-complexity - the rule SonarCloud reports - reproduced 16 before and after that helper; the real contributor was the component's four-state inline branch chain. Extracting it into renderBody() measures 16 -> 10, and 5 for the new function. This packet lands that fix and records the measurement rule as FR-018 plus a guide change, so a static-analysis claim is not merged again without a before/after reading.
findings: PR #463 merged on a claim, not a measurement: the packet's own summary recorded the TenantList reduction as fact, and main's SonarCloud analysis at 1ae6481c still carries typescript:S3776 at TenantList.tsx:116 = 16 (issue key AaF89PoZ78TOH8UMk82y).

can(perm) was behaviourally correct but metrically neutral: sonarjs/cognitive-complexity does not increment for logical operator sequences inside a plain const initializer, so five collapsed || expressions moved nothing.

The measured contributors were the component body's if/else-if/else chain plus the nested ternaries in JSX; extracting the chain into a component-local renderBody() measures the component at 10 and the new function at 5.

The four states are behaviour-identical after extraction: same predicates (tenantModeEnabled, loading && tableData.length === 0, error && tableData.length === 0), same returned elements, same onRetry body, same navigate target, same class names and i18n keys.

in: Extract TenantList's four-state body resolution into a component-local renderBody() and render {renderBody()} instead of {bodyContent}
Add the static-analysis re-measurement rule to docs/harness/AI_QUALITY_GOVERNANCE.md section 5.2
Correct the .harness/STATUS.md Release Gate section so the #463 TenantList claim is marked as falsified and points at this packet
out: Reverting or altering can(perm), which was merged by #463 and remains a valid de-duplication
Any visible behaviour change: predicates, returned elements, class names, i18n keys and onRetry semantics stay identical
Adding eslint-plugin-sonarjs or any other dependency to the repository; the measurement runs in a scratch directory outside the repo
Touching backend, workflows, Sonar configuration or gate thresholds

implementationNotes: renderBody is a nested arrow inside the component, closing over tenantModeEnabled, loading, error, tableData, t, navigate, loadData, query and tableContent; it adds no props, types or imports.
Order of the four states is preserved: compat guide first (it wins even while loading), then first-load PageLoading, then PageRequestError, then the table.

Measurement used eslint-plugin-sonarjs@3's sonarjs/cognitive-complexity in /d/tmp/sonarcheck (outside the repository) against the same file, at the rule's configured threshold 15 and again at threshold 4 to read the true values.
The guide change is scoped to the rule that was missed: static-analysis fixes must be re-measured with the same rule and the before/after readings recorded before commit.

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Treat the previous claim as falsified. Reproduce the reading with the same rule before changing anything, change the smallest surface that lowers the measured value, and re-measure.
reviewerPosture: Confirm the before/after readings come from the same rule and the same file, with the threshold-4 run exposing per-function values.
Diff the four states against the previous if/else-if/else chain: predicates, elements, class names, i18n keys and onRetry must be identical.
Confirm can(perm) is untouched and remains a plain boolean per flag.
Confirm no dependency, workflow, Sonar configuration or threshold changed.
Confirm the guide rule and FR-018 describe the same failure and the same remedy.

Frontend lint / type-check / build readouts after the change
